# Metabolic assessment: implementation and validation plan

26 October 2026 · UI0.3.11/core0.1.1 · Research specification, not completed clinical validation.

## What the current output means

The software reports observations separately: matched-period approximate nitrogen balance, laboratory-derived prognostic proxies, malnutrition criteria, muscle/function measurements and delivered intake. No routine-blood-panel classifier has been validated here to identify individual whole-body or muscle anabolism. A prognostic association does not establish that changing a supplement according to that marker improves outcomes.

Measured energy expenditure, a measurement-time nutrition rate projected ×24, verified cumulative 24-hour delivery and a physician prescription are distinct quantities. A projected rate does not establish actual intake through interruptions or rate changes; delivery relative to a prescription does not measure biological requirement or protein balance. The [EPIC / ECMO-Nutrition source-method note](ENERGY-MEASUREMENT-AND-DELIVERY-SOURCE-METHODS.md) preserves their exposure definitions, analytical choices, cohort overlap and access limits. These distinctions change no calculation or clinical target.

### Focused original-source update

- [Deng et al., 2026](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.clnesp.2026.105009): authorized 26 October main-HTML Methods/Results and six table texts were reviewed; figure images and supplement remain unread. Daily MIMIC-IV modelling differs from first-week-mean/baseline-physiology NEED support. Separate marker strata do not verify a joint AND-window; creatinine interaction P=0.467 and a Table 6 exposure-label conflict remain visible. Both target denominators use IBW, with its equation unspecified. See [original-method audit](DENG-METABOLIC-SOURCE-METHODS.md). Historical VETİS access and this retained source review are distinct events.
- [Zhou et al., DOI 10.1002/jpen.70148](https://doi.org/10.1002/jpen.70148): authorized 25 October 2026 review of original main Methods/Results/displayed tables verifies NEED/ISRCTN12233792, separate Day 1 (n=2613) and Day 7 (n=2516) sets with 2512 shared, and serum urea/creatinine in mmol/mmol. Day 7 strata use operational baseline AKI; survivor/missingness selection and model timing limit interpretation. Earlier access was abstract-only; figures/supplements remain unread. The app's mass ratios stay unchanged; source-derived grouping is not a clinical threshold or guided-dose result. See [original-source methods](UCR-ORIGINAL-SOURCE-METHODS.md).
- [Diethelm et al., EFFORT ward analysis, DOI 10.1016/j.clnesp.2025.03.042](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.clnesp.2025.03.042): public [Wageningen Taverne original](https://edepot.wur.nl/691468) main Methods/tables/Figure 3 reviewed on 25 October 2026. Baseline 1595 of reported 2028; 870 paired follow-ups at day 7 or earlier discharge, with selected availability. Printed division by 1000 conflicts with the reported UCR scale and remains unresolved. Figure 3 interaction p=.26 (baseline)/.80 (change); displayed HR CIs concern strata, not interactions. These results establish neither equivalence nor guided-dose benefit. Supplements/SAP remain unread; see [ICU/ward source methods](UCR-ORIGINAL-SOURCE-METHODS.md).
- [CRRT original open full text2025](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12154268/): methods/results/discussion reviewed. Dialysis changes UCR trajectories and obscures endogenous versus administered protein contributions. No research grouping cutoff is implemented as a patient threshold.
- [ASPEN visceral-protein position](https://doi.org/10.1002/ncp.10588): publisher text reviewed. Albumin/prealbumin changes cannot establish muscle anabolism or direct nutritional titration. Its2021 correction concerns the podcast interviewee name, not the clinical position.
- [JCCNG2024 guideline, published2025](https://doi.org/10.1186/s40560-025-00785-z): CQ3-3/Table12 describes multiple approximate nitrogen-loss methods. UUN+4 is one approximation. Absorption, unmeasured losses and changing urea pools limit single observations.

Access history is source-specific. Earlier Zhou and Diethelm reviews were abstract-only. On 25 October 2026, authorized institutional access enabled Zhou main-text/table review, with its figures/supplements still unread; public WUR access enabled EFFORT main-text/table/Figure 3 review without VETİS, with supplements/SAP unverified. Other sources retain their documented scope. This focused work is not a complete systematic review, formal RoB2/GRADE assessment or prospective validation. Licensed raw material, images and institutional/proxy access links are not redistributed.

## Date and provenance rules in this implementation

Both blood and assessment dates must be real calendar dates before laboratory indices are calculated. An assessment date is required for a program draft. A future blood specimen cannot enter that assessment.

Nitrogen balance additionally requires its own UUN specimen/collection-end date (`uunDate`), distinct from the blood date. It must match the written ISO collection-end calendar day and not exceed the assessment day. The engine compares the written day for zoned as well as unzoned inputs; it does not infer a host timezone or an assessment time of day. Equivalent instants written in different zones may have different days: use a consistent source reporting timezone and reconcile the written dates. Date-only records do not establish within-day recency.

The existing24±0.1h collection tolerance is an engineering eligibility choice, not a clinical validation result. Actual delivered protein must match the collected24h window; complete urine, positive urine volume, absence of declared kidney disease/KRT and major extra losses remain necessary. Future periods and explicit UUN-date conflicts are integrity blockers. Missing UUN date suppresses its estimate without making UUN mandatory for an unrelated nutrition draft. A missing measurement is never a zero result.

Structured imports retain the original UUN date. Editing its date clears the old UUN value and provenance; manually editing UUN replaces its provenance as manual entry. Old research JSON remains readable but receives no invented UUN date. Confirmations reset and the affected estimate stays unavailable until reviewed. Case/assessmentdate changes reset laboratory, collection, product and target confirmations. Invalid input metadata suppresses dependent indices.

In 0.3.11, UCR uses the existing main-form/import creatinine acceptance range (0.1–30 mg/dL), rather than accepting a value the form itself rejected. This is a software data-acceptance range, not a clinical normal interval. Main and clinical invalid-field metadata suppress their dependent UCR/CRP calculations even after confirmations are rechecked; malformed flag lists cannot authorize either paired proxy. An unrelated valid error flag does not suppress an independent laboratory calculation. Error metadata and original values are retained, and measured zero urea/CRP is not changed into missingness. The clinical assessment hash changes; the core arithmetic version remains 0.1.1.

Kidney-history contradictions and declared intestinal failure/high-output losses suppress the simplified nitrogen interpretation in the main view and follow-up, even when the core renal/loss fields appear permissive. Original numeric inputs remain in the record for reconciliation. These are conservative software eligibility rules, not evidence that every patient with such a condition shares one metabolic state.

## Study-ready stages and acceptance gates

1. **Technical verification:** freeze code/source hashes; independent clinicians establish expected results before execution. Include unit/date conflicts, missing and zero values, stale confirmations, reimports, renal/loss contradictions and split/duplicate periods. A critical unsafe numerical result must not be averaged away by high overall accuracy. Record every failure and repair. Automated regression counts measure software behavior, not clinical validity.
2. **Measurement feasibility:** consecutive adult ICU and ward cohorts, analysed separately. Record reasons for missing UUN, urine completeness, actual intake source, kidney/KRT changes, fluid shifts and loss routes. Measure clinician agreement and time burden before defining a derived biological endpoint. Retain excluded observations and reasons. Do not discard early deaths or failed collections silently.
3. **Physiological validity:** predefine whether the target is whole-body nitrogen balance, muscle protein synthesis/breakdown or clinical nutrition status. They are different constructs. If feasible, an expert metabolic-methods collaborator should specify tracer/independent reference methods and matched intervals. UUN+4 cannot be both the candidate classifier and its own independent truth. Serial muscle ultrasound/strength may support longitudinal assessment but do not directly establish whole-body protein turnover; illness/neurological confounding must be recorded.
4. **Model evaluation, only if justified:** prespecify candidate variables and outcome definitions; develop without a fabricated binary label. Separate patient/admission groups and sites/time periods before model fitting; visits from one patient never leak across development/validation. Report missingness, calibration and clinically relevant uncertainty. Estimate sample size from the actual outcome and required precision with a statistician; do not promise a universal minimum. Freeze thresholds before independent external evaluation.
5. **Clinical utility:** any dose-changing strategy requires a separately approved prospective comparison with a prespecified algorithm, control strategy, safety outcomes, stopping rules and allocation. A mortality association, retrospective dose subgroup or non-significant interaction cannot substitute for this stage.

## Work that requires the clinical team

**25 October 2026 technical addition:** [Offline synthetic analysis methods](./ANALYSIS-DRY-RUN-METHODS.md) now specifies a runnable external-ledger dry run for denominators, missingness and repeated matched-window differences. It is separate from the clinical app schema and demonstrates no biological agreement. A synthetic independence flag is not an acquired independent reference. Real-study estimand, acceptable disagreement, reference feasibility, serial-dependence model and sample-size approval remain unresolved.

Before recruiting: final intended-use statement and primary construct; participating centres; ethics approval and consent pathway; investigator roles; reference-measurement feasibility; statistician-approved analysis/sample-size plan; data-controller access, retention and incident rules. The current session-memory prototype is not an institutional patient database or immutable audit system. No real patient recruitment, ethical approval, data governance certification or outcome benefit has been completed by this software work.

## Türkçe uygulama özeti

Ana hedef katabolizma/anabolizmanın güvenilir değerlendirilmesidir; bunun için farklı fizyolojik yapılar tek bir kan indeksiyle eşitlenmez. Azot dengesi yaklaşık ve dönem eşleşmesine bağlıdır. UCR prognozla ilişkili olabilir; ölçüm günü, AKI/KRT ve dışarıdan verilen protein etkisini ayırmaz. Güncel analizlerden otomatik protein, glutamin, lösin, BCAA veya HMB dozu çıkarılmaz.

Kalorimetri harcaması, ölçüm anı hızının 24 ile çarpımı, doğrulanmış 24 saatlik gerçek teslim ve hekim reçetesi aynı ölçüm değildir; reçeteye göre teslim yüzdesi biyolojik gereksinimi veya anabolizmayı doğrulamaz.

0.3.1'de kan tarihi ile UUN tarihi ayrılır. Geçerli değerlendirme tarihi olmadan laboratuvar indeksleri üretilmez. UUN tarihi yazılan toplama bitiş günüyle eşleşir; gelecek dönem veya açık çelişki değerlendirmeye alınmaz. Tarih, ölçüm veya olgu değişince ilgili onaylar yenilenir. Eski kayda tarih uydurulmaz. Böbrek/önemli bağırsak kaybı çelişkisi ana ekranda ve izlemde azot yorumunu kapatır; ham veriyi silmez.

Tez için teknik testlerden sonra ölçüm uygulanabilirliği, bağımsız fizyolojik referans, önceden tanımlanmış model değerlendirmesi ve ayrı klinik yarar araştırması gerekir. Etik kurul, gerçek veri, merkezler ve bağımsız uzman değerlendirmesi kullanıcı/araştırma ekibiyle tamamlanacak aşamalardır. Bu belge yürütülmüş veya olumlu sonuçlanmış bir çalışma raporu değildir.
